# skio

> skio is a family of open-source (BSD-3-Clause) Flutter plugins for hardware. `skio_usb_serial` talks to USB serial devices (ESP32, STM32, Nordic nRF and Arduino boards, and CH340, CP210x, FTDI, PL2303 and CDC-ACM adapters) on Android, macOS and the web. `skio_uart` opens serial ports by path: the UART, RS-232 and RS-485 ports built into Android panels, Jetson and Raspberry Pi boards, Windows COM ports, and USB adapters on Linux and macOS. `skio_uvc_camera` gives a live preview, JPEG photos and the snapshot button of USB (UVC) cameras such as endoscopes, microscopes and webcams. Android support calls the OS directly through JNI (jnigen); macOS and `skio_uart` use `dart:ffi` with no native code to compile; the web uses Web Serial and getUserMedia. There are no platform channels. `skio_usb_serial`, `skio_uvc_camera` and `skio_core` are stable (0.2.x); `skio_uart` is in beta (0.1.0-beta.1). All are published by the verified publisher skio-flutter.dev from GitHub Actions and collect no telemetry.

Use skio when a Flutter app needs to:

- Send and receive data with a USB serial device on Android (USB OTG), macOS or in Chrome/Edge (Web Serial): `flutter pub add skio_usb_serial`
- Open a serial port by path (`/dev/ttyS3`, `/dev/ttyTHS1`, `COM3`, `/dev/ttyUSB0`) on Android panels, Linux, Windows or macOS, from Flutter or plain Dart: `flutter pub add skio_uart` or `dart pub add skio_uart`
- Show and capture a USB camera (UVC) on Android (USB OTG) or in the browser: `flutter pub add skio_uvc_camera`

Platforms today: `skio_usb_serial` on Android 7.0+, macOS and the web (desktop Chrome/Edge over https); `skio_uart` on Android, Linux, Windows and macOS; `skio_uvc_camera` on Android 7.0+ and the web. In progress: `skio_usb_serial` on Windows and Linux (use `skio_uart` there today), and `skio_uvc_camera` on macOS, Windows and Linux. iPad (USB cameras only) is planned. iOS apps cannot use USB serial adapters (Apple restriction).

## Packages

- [skio_usb_serial](https://pub.dev/packages/skio_usb_serial): USB serial ports. `UsbSerialPort.list()`, `UsbSerialPort.request()` (web chooser), `UsbSerialPort.open(device, config: SerialConfig(baudRate: 115200))`, `port.input` (byte stream), `port.write(bytes)`, `LineReader` (text lines), `setSignals(dtr:, rts:)`, `UsbSerialPort.events` (plug/unplug).
- [skio_uart](https://pub.dev/packages/skio_uart): serial ports by path, pure Dart FFI. `SerialPort.list(filters:)`, `SerialPort.open('/dev/ttyS3', config: SerialConfig(baudRate: 9600))`, `port.input` (byte stream), `port.write(bytes)`, `port.drain()`, `LineReader`, `setSignals(dtr:, rts:)`, `getSignals()`, `flush()`, `sendBreak()`, `SerialPort.events` (added/removed ports).
- [skio_uvc_camera](https://pub.dev/packages/skio_uvc_camera): USB cameras. `UvcCamera.devices()`, `UvcCamera.access.requestAccess(device)`, `UvcCamera.open(device, preferred: [UvcSize(1920, 1080), UvcSize(1280, 720)])`, `UvcPreview(camera: cam)`, `cam.capture(quality: 90)` (JPEG XFile), `cam.buttonPresses` (snapshot button), `cam.supportedSizes`.
- [skio_core](https://pub.dev/packages/skio_core): shared types re-exported by every skio package: `HardwareAccess`/`AccessStatus` (permissions), sealed `HardwareException` (`AccessDenied`, `DeviceNotFound`, `DeviceBusy`, `Disconnected`, `OperationTimeout`, `Unsupported`, `ProtocolError`), `DeviceHandle`, `DeviceFilter`, `SkioLog` (opt-in logging).

## Docs

- [skio_usb_serial README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/skio-flutter/skio/main/packages/skio_usb_serial/README.md): every feature with examples, errors table, troubleshooting, tested hardware, FAQ
- [skio_uart README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/skio-flutter/skio/main/packages/skio_uart/README.md): platforms, install per OS, wiring a UART device, errors, troubleshooting, FAQ
- [skio_uvc_camera README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/skio-flutter/skio/main/packages/skio_uvc_camera/README.md): every feature with examples, including choosing the resolution
- [skio_core README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/skio-flutter/skio/main/packages/skio_core/README.md): permissions, errors, device filters, logging
- [API reference (skio_usb_serial)](https://pub.dev/documentation/skio_usb_serial/latest/)
- [API reference (skio_uart)](https://pub.dev/documentation/skio_uart/latest/)
- [API reference (skio_uvc_camera)](https://pub.dev/documentation/skio_uvc_camera/latest/)

## Examples

- [Serial terminal example](https://github.com/skio-flutter/skio/tree/main/packages/skio_usb_serial/example): pick a port, set baud/parity, text or hex, DTR/RTS, in-app log
- [UART terminal example](https://github.com/skio-flutter/skio/tree/main/packages/skio_uart/example): type a port path or pick a detected port, settings, text or hex, modem lines, logs; Android, Linux, Windows, macOS
- [USB camera viewer example](https://github.com/skio-flutter/skio/tree/main/packages/skio_uvc_camera/example): preview, resolution menu, capture, snapshot button, delete photos

## Tested hardware

- Boards: ESP32 (via CH340), STM32, Nordic nRF
- Phones: vivo, OPPO, Samsung, POCO M7 5G (Android 16)
- Mac: macOS app with an ESP32 through its CH340 chip
- Browser: Chrome on macOS (Web Serial)
- Camera: Sonix-based UVC camera on Android 16
